sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, face Dawley Town away on Saturday 31 October at 15:00. The leaders have won four of their last five league matches, though they suffered a recent loss; this trip to mid-table Dawley (16 points, currently on a mixed run) presents an opportunity to bounce back and extend their advantage at the summit.
divisionWide: Tuesday's lone fixture sees struggling Telford Town (7 points, five losses in their last six league games) host Eccleshall (22 points), who arrive in decent form with a recent win. On Saturday, a congested fixture list sees several key battles: second-place AFC Bridgnorth's title credentials are on hold, but Bilston Town (3rd, 26 points) continue their excellent run of five consecutive league wins and will be watching closely. Stafford Town (4th, 26 points) entertain top-of-the-table Sandbach in a direct title-race clash, with Stafford themselves in an inconsistent spell (D-D-W-D-D). Wolverhampton Casuals (5th, 25 points) host Allscott Heath (8th, 20 points, five league wins in their last six), a promising outfit looking to continue their strong form. In the middle tier, Foley Meir welcome Barnton (6th, 22 points, who have won four of their last five league matches), while Eccleshall face Shawbury United in another fixture. Lower down the table, New Mills host Wednesfield Community in a mid-table battle, and Cheadle Heath Nomads (17 points) take on struggling Brereton Social (14 points). Market Drayton Town, also struggling near the bottom, visit Crewe (12 points, without a win in their last three league games). Finally, Widnes Town (6 points, one of the division's poorest records) travel to Alsager Town (7 points, five losses in their last six league matches) in a basement battle.
